name: Spicy Chickpea Stew (Chana Masala) with Rice & Cilantro-Lime Raita

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 jalapeño pepper
2 limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel and mince garlic and ginger; place in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the garlic and ginger; set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat another medium saucepan over medium heat.
While the pan heats up, peel and small dice onion.
Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Set aside to drain further.
Add garlic, ginger, jalapeño, and spices to the pan with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp cumin, ground
2 tsp coriander, ground
2 tsp curry powder
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
⅛ tsp turmeric, ground
⅛ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: Add chickpeas, broth, and diced tomatoes to the pan; stir to combine and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until chickpeas are soft and stew has thickened, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
16 fl oz (2 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: While the stew cooks, juice one lime into the reserved bowl. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with yogurt, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the raita.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the stew is done, add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Divide rice and chickpea stew between bowls; serve with lime wedges and raita on the side. Enjoy!
